Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compared the interactomes of a phosphorylation-deficient mutant (S1179A) and a phosphorylation-mimetic mutant (S1179D) of eNOS. While the paper describes other perturbations (SDF2 knockdown/overexpression, VEGF stimulation, GA treatment), these were validated via immunoblotting and NO release assays, not the mass spectrometry analysis described in the 'Mass spectrometry' and 'TAP combined with MS' sections.
